QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Kurama's Delusion
QuestInfo.0: Check the sign Kurama put up at the Mushroom Shrine.
QuestInfo.1: Things didn't go according the Kurama's plan and Izuna did not win the Beauty poll. Kurama decides to rig the vote.
QuestInfo.2: Kurama rigged the beauty poll, but a furious Kino Konoko tore up the results before Izuna could see them. Now what?
